This '''Rebel outpost''' was established by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] learned of the Rebel presence and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led an [[Battle of Mygeeto (Galactic Civil War)|invasion]] to recapture it. The Imperials were victorious and the outpost was destroyed.
